title: Units of measure: settle who owns sys_unit, its fields and who may create, relabel or delete an org unit (ADR-0158 Open item 2)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Routed by [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md#open-items), Open item 2, to the `sys_unit` card. Parent: #35339 (ADR merged in PR #35370, 35bd36082c).

## Question (the ADR's text)
`sys_unit`'s owning package, its fields and its write grants. Its fields beyond what U3, U6, U7 R2, L1 and L2 name, against ADR-0029 D1, D3 and D6 (ADR-0144 D3 left `sys_exchange_rate`'s owner to its card the same way). Its write grants: who creates, relabels and deletes an org unit. The seat's L1 settlement names only who edits a ratio (an organization admin, audited), and a delete is the act L1 attaches refusals to.

## Done when
The `sys_unit` card states the owning package, the full field list and the create / relabel / delete grants, and ADR-0158 is amended with the answer (the way ADR-0144's open items were). Open item 11 (a deleted code created again) is the same card's, filed beside this one under #35339.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:spec. R1's membership check (U5) reads `sys_unit` rows, so R1 cannot start until the object exists.
